gcme1c: The biggest change is how someone joins. You send them a link of their own. They fill in their part on their phone, add their dependants and beneficiaries, and sign right on the screen. Their health answers go to Guardian, never to you.

Then you check their details and approve. Guardian's own enrolment form is filled in and sent to Guardian's group team, and your account manager follows it up every three working days. You'll see where it stands on your page, and in your Monday report, until it's done.

We also look ahead for your people. We tell you before someone turns sixty five, before a child comes of age and leaves the family plan, and before someone retires on your company pension, so there are no surprises, and we can help each person before it happens.
